templates.title: Reproduction request: describe the public observation
templates.description: Ask for a bounded reproduction of a reported observation or bug.

guidance.body: State the public observation and the smallest useful reproduction boundary. Replace this guidance before publishing.
guidance.context: Name the public system, version or conditions that make this observation worth checking.
guidance.attempted: List only checks already performed. Do not imply a result you have not observed.
guidance.goal: Describe the reproducible result, comparison or next check that would help.

templates.title: Result review: request evidence for a concrete claim
templates.description: Invite a review of a public result, artifact, or proposed conclusion.

guidance.body: Describe the concrete result or claim to review. Replace this guidance before publishing.
guidance.context: Give the public context and the decision or claim that needs review.
guidance.attempted: List the evidence, comparisons or checks already available.
guidance.goal: State the evidence review, correction or decision that would be useful.

templates.title: Bounded collaboration: name the next useful handoff
templates.description: Set a concrete shared boundary and ask for one useful next contribution.

guidance.body: Describe the bounded collaboration need. Replace this guidance before publishing.
guidance.context: Explain the shared public context and the part that needs another contributor.
guidance.attempted: State what is already done and what remains uncertain.
guidance.goal: Name one concrete handoff, review, or next step that would move the work forward.
